like say a crowded mall, i'm not that weird anti social creepy guy ( probably just a little ;) ) but it still feels weird being there and want to get out as soon as possible? i'm not sure if this is the right sub for this but i really like to read some of trp advice.
any material for getting more confidence in public settings?

Just overload your system with public settings. You said you "want to get out as soon as possible." Take away that option. Tell yourself you're not leaving for three hours, no matter what. So you can sit in the food court and people watch, browse the stores, whatever. No matter what you end up doing, it's going to be more helpful for your social skills than leaving.

If you don't talk to anyone, chalk it up to field experience and do the same thing the next day. If you need a harder push, say you won't leave until you talk to 8 people. It's going to suck and you'll feel like an idiot, but that's because it's work. And you don't get rewards without work. To put a RP spin on this, you're not there because you care what people think. So what if they think you're awkward or weird? You're there to improve yourself. That should be the only thing on your mind, because that should be important enough to work for.

Liverpool FC boss Brendan Rodgers has a big decision over who partners Christian Benteke on the opening day

Hmm so of the choice of the wing forwards they're looking at Lallana, Ibe, Coutinho, Firminho.

If Ibe is on form, I'd like to see him get a few starts and see what his ceiling is or get a glimpse of his potential early in the season. If he looks a flop, then the selection has gotten that much easier: drop him from the league and have him start in league cup, FA cup and Europa matches. I'm hoping Firminho is eased into it as opposed to thrown to the wolves, but if he's a big enough star this would be a mistake.

I'm of the opinion Coutinho works well in midfield if he can keep up the pressing duties. I see him fighting for a spot with Allen as the partner to Hendo in CM. It'd go a long way against teams that are hard to breakdown as Allen wouldn't help as much there.

So in short, I'd take Lallana and Ibe. Drop one for Firminho if one of their forms take a dip and let the new boy ease into it. Coutinho takes a place in midfield only if he can keep up the pressing duties.

This is a tricky one. I am sure being able to see the players in practice makes the decisions much easier, but we will want to see Firmino start form the begining to get a look at how he can perform. I am hoping all the new players can hit the ground running. For the first time in a while we have a good lot of players to choose from, that can play in different formations and switch up play quite fast. Every fan will have his prefered player or formation obviously but hopefully we find one that works and we can get on a good run from the begining.
